chapter_title: Concerning the Seed Grain that shall be formed by the Elements, and also be destroyed by them
chapter_note: Dominantly cosmological/process teaching using a seed-grain analogy: the five elements form/nourish, and the same cycle also entails deprivation/blight as Matter casts its shadow. Only paragraph 3 clearly pivots into institutional application (teachers/elect) while borrowing the analogy’s syntax.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic/dialogue frame attribution: "Once again the apostle... speaks to his disciples" with ecclesial title "builder of the church"—a compilation-layer wrapper.

paragraphs.core_text: “This seed grain and this barley grain that you see shall be formed and [...] and beautified by the five elements. Now, the warmth and the cold nourish the seed grain and the entire tree. So, just as these things nourish it [...] it is destroyed [...] through [...] hunger.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal correspondential mechanism within the cosmic/natural system (grain/tree ↔ five elements; warmth/cold; nourishment ↔ destruction) with no institutional targeting or exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way also righteousness gathers the five to it.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/application continuation: "So, it shall be chosen by the teachers and the elect; and they gather it in and ornament it [...]" etc. This shifts from cosmic mechanism to church roles (teachers/elect) performing the ‘gathering,’ i.e., cosmos → contemporary community mapping.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens with a system-internal salvific statement (righteousness + five), then pivots to Manichaean institutional agents (teachers/elect) and their activity, indicating editorial application grafted onto an older analogical line.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way too, a lack and a shortfall shall occur from place to place through them; and they who have chosen it have gathered it in and beautified and attained it, while an affliction shall arise for it through those.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal cycle logic (gain here ↔ lack elsewhere; affliction arising) without explicit church terminology. Attribution of agency (“they who have chosen it”) is ambiguous, but the paragraph still reads as systemic consequence within the elements/mixture framework.

paragraphs.core_text: “People also shall be caused to stumble on their account, through the energy of Matter that dwells in them. It has poured its shadow over them, just as it shall also pour its shadow over the elements and destroy the fruits of all the trees.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systemic cosmology of Mixture: Matter as an agent with operations (dwells, pours shadow, destroys fruits) affecting people and elements alike; not exhortation but description of how the mechanism works.
